title: AI Automation & Systems Integration Developer – Phase 1 (Operational SLA System)
description:
We are a multi-location tattoo removal company operating across Australia, New Zealand, and the USA.

We are looking for an experienced automation / AI systems developer to build Phase 1 of an internal operational management system.

Important:
This is NOT a full ERP or large-scale AI platform build initially.

We want to start with a focused, high-ROI operational automation layer first, then expand in later phases.

# Current Systems

We currently use:

* [Clinicea](https://www.clinicea.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com) (CRM / clinic management)
* [3CX](https://www.3cx.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com) (phones + SMS)
* [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
* [Microsoft Outlook](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/microsoft-365/outlook/email-and-calendar-software-microsoft-outlook?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
* [Google Sheets](https://www.google.com/sheets/about/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
* [Google Ads](https://ads.google.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

We have already mapped our systems internally and understand the workflows.

# Phase 1 Scope (ONLY)

We are specifically looking to build:

## 1. Communication SLA Monitoring System

Monitor:

* Missed calls
* Unanswered SMS
* Unanswered emails

Required SLA rules:

* Missed calls must be followed up within 5 minutes
* SMS replied to within 10 minutes
* Emails replied to within 10 minutes

Required functionality:

* Detect SLA breaches
* Send Teams alerts automatically
* Escalate unresolved items to management
* Log response times
* Produce simple daily summaries

Integrations required:

* 3CX
* Outlook
* Teams

---

## 2. Google Sheets Task Compliance Monitoring

Need to:

* Detect overdue tasks
* Detect sheets not updated
* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly operational checklists
* Send Teams reminders/escalations automatically

---

## 3. Basic Operational Reporting

Simple reporting only:

* Missed calls
* SLA breaches
* Response times
* Overdue tasks
* Daily clinic summaries

No advanced dashboards required initially.

---

# NOT Required In Phase 1

Please do NOT quote for:

* AI productivity scoring
* Predictive analytics
* Advanced dashboards
* AI receptionist
* Deep marketing attribution
* Executive AI summaries
* Complex BI systems

These may become Phase 2+ later.

---

# Preferred Stack

Open to recommendations, but likely:

* Python
* n8n or Make.com
* PostgreSQL or similar database
* Microsoft Graph API
* 3CX integrations/webhooks

Hybrid architecture preferred.

---

# What We Want From You

Please provide:

* Relevant experience
* Similar automation/API integration projects
* Recommended architecture
* Estimated timeline
* Estimated hours
* Suggested stack
* Any API limitations or risks you foresee

Please keep the quote focused on Phase 1 only.

Thanks,
Mike

Sports betting / prediction market quant background
Mandarin Chinese reading ability (some internal docs are bilingual)
React + Tailwind frontend experience
Background in maker/taker fee optimization

Simulated trades, no real money
Telegram signal notifications (no execution)

Real Kalshi order execution with $200 position cap
Shift-aware Telegram operator confirmation flow (3 operators across 2 time zones)

GitHub link or zipped repo showing a real-time trading bot, market data pipeline, or LLM-powered automation you have built. (Private repos OK — share via invite.)

title: AI Agent for Insurance Brokerage - Leads Generation
description:
This requirement specification outlines the development of an integrated AI ecosystem for **Henderson Capital**. 

The system will bridge the gap between web-based traffic and high-touch financial lead qualification through a "Chat-to-Voice" automated pipeline.
## 1. Project Overview
**Client:** Henderson Capital
**Objective:** Deploy a multi-channel AI lead generation system that engages website visitors via a smart chatbot and follows up via an AI-powered VOIP voice agent to qualify leads for investment, insurance, and other financial services.
## 2. System Architecture & Flow
The system follows a three-stage funnel:
 1. **Engagement:** Web Chatbot captures intent and contact data.
 2. **Handoff:** Instant data push to the VOIP AI Agent via Webhooks/API.
 3. **Qualification:** Voice AI calls the lead to perform discovery (BANT or bespoke framework) and books a meeting with a human advisor.
## 3. Functional Requirements
### A. The "Smart" Web Chatbot
 * **Persona:** Professional, knowledgeable, and proactive.
 * **Routing Logic:** Must categorize visitors into:
   * *Insurance Enquiries* (Life, Asset, Business)
   * *Investment Management* (Equities, Alternatives, Fixed Income)
   * *General Enquiries*
 * **Intelligent Discovery:** Instead of static forms, use **Dynamic Slot Filling**. If a user says "I want to invest R1m," the bot skips the "How much do you want to invest?" question and moves to "What is your risk appetite?"
 * **Lead Capture:** Mandatory collection of Name, Phone Number (validated), and Email before handoff.
### B. The VOIP AI Voice Agent
 * **Trigger:** Automated outbound call triggered within **60 seconds** of a "High Intent" lead being captured on the site.
 * **Voice Characteristics:** South African localized accent (if possible), natural latency ( less than 800ms), and human-like turn-taking.
 * **Qualification Scripting:** * **Verify Identity:** "Hi, is this [Name]? I'm calling from Henderson Capital regarding your insurance enquiry."
   * **Discovery:** Ask 3–5 qualifying questions (e.g., "Are you looking for personal or commercial coverage?" or "What is your current investment horizon?").
   * **Objection Handling:** Ability to answer basic FAQs about Henderson Capital services using a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge base.
 * **Scheduling:** If qualified, the agent must offer available slots and book a meeting directly into an advisor's calendar (e.g., Calendly or Outlook).
### C. Integration & Management
 * **CRM Integration:** All chat logs and call transcripts must be pushed to a CRM (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, or a custom DB).
 * **Lead Scoring:** Assign a "Hot/Warm/Cold" status based on the AI Voice Agent’s conversation summary.
 * **Dashboard:** A portal for Henderson Capital staff to view active leads, listen to call recordings, and see conversion rates.
## 4. Technical Stack (Recommended)
 * **Web Bot:** OpenAI GPT-4o API / LangChain for logic; React/Tailwind for the UI.
 * **Voice Engine:** **Retell AI**, **Vapi**, or **Bland AI** (for low-latency VOIP/LLM integration).
 * **Telephony:** Twilio or Telnyx for South African DID numbers.
 * **Backend:** Node.js or Python (FastAPI) to handle webhooks between the chat and voice systems.
## 5. Compliance & Security
 * **POPIA Compliance:** The system must include a "Consent to Call" checkbox in the chat interface and provide an opt-out mechanism during the voice call.
 * **Data Encryption:** All PII (Personally Identifiable Information) must be encrypted at rest and in transit (AES-256).
## 6. Success Metrics (KPIs)
 * **Engagement Rate:** Percentage of web visitors who start a chat.
 * **Lead-to-Call Speed:** Target  less than 2 minutes for the AI to initiate the VOIP call.
 * **Qualification Rate:** Percentage of leads that reach the "Meeting Booked" stage.

title: Create AI Quant Agent (pairs trading)

(I'm reposting an early job in this new variant.)

Hi, I have been working a couple of weeks on pairs trading analysis for perps in anticipation of deploying a diversified (npairs 50+) model. It's been me battling with Claude Code, feeding it price history, funding, OI, order book data, etc. Calculating all sorts of weird metrics. Backtesting, slicing and dicing, trying to avoid p-hacking, etc. Since I'm not a quant by trade, there's a lot of learning along the way... but the thing I'm noticing is that I am not a particularly high value manager of this process, and tbh I'm not sure many humans would be. We're just sacks of meat holding the model back.

So what if instead of trying to pretend I'm a quant asking a model to do stuff, what if we created an agentic quant that, given enough goals/constraints/data/tools, can do what I'm trying to without me doing it. To a large extent it's just a variation of autoresearch/ralph loops/goal command in cc/codex. But it's done with some skills that keep it on-track, provide guard rails, etc. 

The deliverable is a set of skills or plugin that acts like a human quant, can interview the user (me), understand general direction, guide where necessary, do web research, pull together data, run experiments, improve them, etc.

So, wait, I'm asking you to help me build an agentic quant for some lunch money? Yup. Because you'll learn 100x more working on this than you will grinding out your next pinescript indicator. It might not work. It might be garbage. It might be life-changing. Dunno, but I'm going to work on it.
